title: Your first resume
description: Start with a sample, change your details, and export a PDF.
steps: Open a template and choose A4 or US Letter.
Change sample details in Code or use your selected AI.
Save the project, read the PDF, and export it.
alt: Your first resume in the real Folio app

title: Templates and paper size
description: Six original layouts with real PDF thumbnails and bundled fonts.
steps: Open Templates in the sidebar.
Choose a paper size and inspect the thumbnail.
Select a style and replace the sample facts.
alt: Templates and paper size in the real Folio app

title: Chat and agent progress
description: The local test fixture renames a heading while the real compiler and history run.
steps: Send a clear request.
Watch reading, editing, building, and PDF review progress.
Inspect the result; use Stop or Retry when needed.
kind: Real app · scripted local AI fixture
alt: Chat and agent progress in the real Folio app

title: Codex subscription
description: Setup is shown with empty credentials. This does not prove live account compatibility.
steps: Open Settings → AI connections → Add connection.
Fill your own connection details and save.
Select the connection, check it, and test image support.
alt: Codex subscription in the real Folio app

title: Visual PDF feedback
description: Highlight, box, draw, or leave a note. Attach the marked area to Chat.
steps: Pick a tool and mark the page.
Write an instruction and save the note.
Select notes, attach them to Chat, and send.
kind: Real app · scripted local AI fixture
alt: Visual PDF feedback in the real Folio app

title: Compare, undo and restore
description: Inspect an earlier PDF beside the current one.
steps: Open History or Compare changes.
Select an earlier version and read both PDFs.
Restore the selected version or use Undo for a recent edit.
kind: Real app · scripted local AI fixture
alt: Compare, undo and restore in the real Folio app

title: Code and build errors
description: The Code tab supports search, per-file undo, snippets and compilation.
steps: Edit text while preserving TeX commands.
Compile and inspect diagnostics if the build fails.
Fix the source, rebuild, and check Up to date.
alt: Code and build errors in the real Folio app

title: Understand a build error
description: Real compiler errors get specific next steps while the last successful PDF stays visible.
steps: Read the explanation above the original errors in Build output.
Select a source-linked error or open Raw log for detail.
Apply the supported fix, compile again, and wait for Up to date.
alt: Missing-font guidance beside the last successful PDF in Folio

title: Use your own fonts
description: Choose font files, review the real PDF, then save them with your resume.
steps: Open More project actions → Add local fonts….
Choose regular and optional style files; build the preview.
Review every page, then choose Use fonts & save or Cancel.
alt: Local OTF font selections beside a real Folio resume preview before saving

title: Files and retained copies
description: Create, rename, remove and restore source files.
steps: Add a source file and reference it from the main file.
Use its menu to rename or remove it, then save.
Open Removed files & saved copies to restore text.
alt: Files and retained copies in the real Folio app

title: Open, import and export source
description: Inspect an archive, select the main document, and keep an independent copy.
steps: Choose Import ZIP project from the project menu.
Review skipped files and choose the main TeX document.
Pick a location; inspect the PDF and export source when needed.
alt: Open, import and export source in the real Folio app

title: Recover an import
description: A real helper interruption creates the recovery state in a disposable test folder.
steps: Open the interrupted-import review.
Finish or reopen a verified copy.
Keep outside edits; dismiss recovery only when you intend to.
alt: Recover an import in the real Folio app

title: Save and autosave
description: Choose a project folder once, then optionally enable autosave.
steps: Save the project and wait for Saved locally.
Enable Autosave project in General settings.
Review any outside-change or error message before continuing.
alt: Save and autosave in the real Folio app

title: Review outside changes
description: Choose how to handle files edited by another app.
steps: Open Review changes and read the list.
Keep editing, save a copy, or reload disk files.
Find preserved editor text in Removed files & saved copies.
alt: Review outside changes in the real Folio app

title: Read and export the PDF
description: Navigate, zoom, select text and export a current, clean PDF.
steps: Use the arrows, page number or scrolling.
Use selection mode for text and links, or a mark tool for notes.
Check Up to date, then export without feedback marks.
alt: Read and export the PDF in the real Folio app

title: Themes and workspace layout
description: Adjust the workspace to fit the way you write.
steps: Choose Dark, Light or System appearance.
Drag a divider or use Tab and arrow keys to resize.
Reset pane sizes in General when needed.
alt: Themes and workspace layout in the real Folio app

title: Editor and PDF preferences
description: Text size and automatic preview are separate from the resume typography.
steps: Open Settings → Editor & PDF.
Choose a comfortable editor size.
Turn automatic preview on or compile manually.
alt: Editor and PDF preferences in the real Folio app

title: Offline compiler repair
description: A deliberate test corruption demonstrates the repair flow.
steps: Read the message in Settings → About.
Repair from a matching local compiler copy.
Wait for ready, rebuild, and inspect the PDF.
alt: Offline compiler repair in the real Folio app

title: Compare compiler versions
description: The test uses a synthetic previous compiler identity and real PDFs.
steps: Start the comparison from Settings.
Inspect both PDFs and the retained backup.
Keep the recorded compiler or explicitly apply the included one.
alt: Compare compiler versions in the real Folio app

title: Privacy and support
description: Understand what stays local and what leaves when you send a chat.
steps: Read Settings → Privacy.
Check source ZIP contents before sharing.
Use Help for shortcuts and About for the app version.
alt: Privacy and support in the real Folio app

title: Review a support bundle
description: Share a small diagnostic summary after reviewing exactly what it contains.
steps: Open Settings → Privacy → Review support bundle.
Read each file and untick any section to leave it out.
Save the support ZIP locally; share it yourself when ready.
kind: Real app · synthetic private markers and compiler failure
alt: Folio support bundle preview with compiler status and no raw log or source text

title: Recover an interrupted save
description: Compare file versions and keep your outside edits and unfinished drafts.
steps: Open Interrupted saves from the project menu or failed startup.
Choose the current, before-save or attempted version of each file.
Review your choices, apply with backups, then check the rebuilt PDF.
kind: Real app · controlled interruption and outside-edit fixture
alt: Folio interrupted-save review showing current, before-save and attempted copies of a synthetic resume

title: Review a signed resource pack
description: Development workflow: review an original sample pack using a temporary test publisher. Public pack publishing is not configured yet.
steps: Open Settings → LaTeX resources in a publisher-configured build.
Choose Import pack file and read its name, requirements and notices.
Install the reviewed bytes or discard the import.
kind: Real source app · temporary test publisher
alt: A signed sample pack and its notices in the dark Folio Settings window

title: Install and retry a pack offline
description: The test uses simulated catalog downloads and real compiler checks. Installing keeps the project’s compiler choice unchanged.
steps: Download a pack; cancellation keeps its received part for resume.
Retry a retained signed archive offline after an interrupted installation.
Wait for checks to finish, then preview it for the project.
alt: An installed test pack with a project preview action in the compact light Folio Settings window

title: Preview a pack before using it
description: A controlled missing package prevents the old build. The test pack produces a real PDF, with a backup and explicit Apply.
steps: Choose Preview for this project, then Build comparison.
Read the new PDF and the explanation for an unavailable before PDF.
Choose Use this pack only when ready, then save.
alt: A real PDF beside an honest unavailable-before message in Folio’s compiler comparison
